parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container of the search field. It holds the search text and the state, and it gives the context to all of the parts.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts of the search field.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: value
props.description: The search text. You can bind it with `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The search text at the start, for when you give no `value`. A form reset goes back to it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the search text changes.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: The component calls it with the search text when the user presses `Enter` in the input.

props.name: onClear
props.description: The component calls it after the `Escape` key or the clear button empties the input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and the clear button.

props.name: readonly
props.description: The user cannot change the text. The `Escape` key and the clear button do nothing.

props.name: required
props.description: Tells a form that it must have a value. The input gets the native `required`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as invalid. The input gets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Marks the value as invalid, the same as `invalid`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input in a form. The form submits the search text with this name.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the search text is empty.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input shows a keyboard focus ring.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present when the focus is in the field.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-search-field-root
dataAttributes.description: Always present on the root element.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: A native label for the input. A click on it moves the focus to the input.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-search-field-label
dataAttributes.description: Always present on the label element.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: The native search input. It holds the text, and it handles the `Escape` key and the `Enter` key.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: type
props.description:
The type of the input. Keep `search`, because it gives the input the `searchbox` role.
Change it only when the field holds a different kind of text, for example an email.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the search text is empty.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present when the focus came from the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present when the pointer is on the input.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-search-field-input
dataAttributes.description: Always present on the input element.

parts.name: Clear
parts.description: The button that empties the search text. It is not in the tab order, and a press on it keeps the focus in the input. It is disabled while the text is empty.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button. If you give none, the component shows an "x" icon.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the search text is empty.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-search-field-clear
dataAttributes.description: Always present on the clear button.
